abstract: |
  This work is focused on testing multiple versions of flapping wing mechanisms
  to improve the lift generating capabilities of the mechanisms. Three
  mechanisms are considered in this work, a traditional four bar linkage
  version, a four bar mechanism which used ball joints, and a four bar mechanism
  with a sector and output gear for amplified motion. The traditional four bar
  version has a wing stroke amplitude of about 55◦ while the other two
  mechanisms have an amplitude of nearly 90 deg. The criteria for comparison is
  the lift force generating capacity of each mechanism. For each mechanism, the
  forward kinematics are derived for use in a table lookup so that symmetric and
  asymmetric flapping can be achieved as desired.
